brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested a Palestinian citizen and his son following an attack by settlers on their residence in Hawara, east of Yatta, the Ma'an news agency reported. The circumstances surrounding the assault and subsequent detentions were not immediately detailed.

The incident marks a recurrence of settler violence in the area, which has experienced repeated confrontations between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in recent months.
title: Israeli forces arrest Palestinian man and son after settlers attack their home
